title: Apple's shock revenue warning causes its value to drop a staggering $446 BILLION in just two months
text: India Apple's shock revenue warning causes its value to drop a staggering $446 BILLION in just two months Thursday, 3 January 2019 ( 14 minutes ago ) Apple shares plunged over 8 percent today as Wall Street was rattled by the Silicon Valley giant's shock revenue warning.
